programme.desc: Los chicos se quedan atrapados fumando y el colegio se incendia. Un grupo radican antitabaco llega al pueblo y quiere matar a Cartman para demostrar que el tabaquismo pasivo mata.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pasas
programme.desc: Wendy deja a Stan y este se convierte en gótico para regodearse en su dolor.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Es Navidad en Canadá
programme.desc: Los padres biológicos de Ike, el hermano adoptivo de Kyle, consiguen llevárselo a Canadá porque el presidente canadiense ha decretado que todos los niños adoptados de Canadá tienen que ser devueltos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Buenos tiempos con armas
programme.desc: Después de comprar armas de artes marciales en un mercadillo, los chicos se transforman en guerreros japoneses de anime con desastrosas consecuencias para el pobre Butters.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Genial-O, mi amigo robot
programme.desc: Cartman se disfraza de robot, se llama a sí mismo GENIAL-O y se muda con Butters. Su plan es descubrir los mayores secretos de Butters y entonces usarlos contra él.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Abajo con los esteroides
programme.desc: Son los Juegos paralímpicos de South Park y Cartman tiene que convencer al comité de que tiene una discapacidad para poder derrotar a Jimmy en el evento

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Espaldas babosas
programme.desc: South Park está abarrotado de trabajadores del futuro que aceptan todos los trabajos por menos dinero. Los hombres de South Park toman medidas curiosas para detenerlos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Los Jefferson
programme.desc: Una nueva familia llega a South Park con un niño que se llama Blanket, un parque de atracciones en el jardín y un padre al que le gusta cantar y la cirugía estética. ¿Adivinas quién es?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Ducha y zurullo
programme.desc: Cuando la PETA acaba con la mascota de South Park, las ideas para sustituirla dividen al colegio. Sean Combs amenaza a Stan y es expulsado del pueblo por negarse a votar.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Algo de Wall-Mart se aproxima
programme.desc: Wall-Mart convierte South Park en un pueblo fantasma, así que Stan y Kyle intentan destruirlo, pero un Cartman poseído se interpone en su camino.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Preescolar
programme.desc: Los chicos están en un buen lío cuando un chaval al que acusaron de prenderle fuego a un profesor sale del centro de menores.

programme.title: Vuelo 192
programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: Oceans Rising
programme.desc: Un científico construye un arca enorme después de que se ignoran sus advertencias de una inundación que destruirá la Tierra.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren algo horrible: el "Gran Terremoto" será en dos días y hundirá California en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplazará la energía del terremoto y construirá una nueva corteza en la superficie.

programme.title: La era del mañana
programme.desc: Cuando el sol golpea un altar, escondido dentro de la antigua Pirámide del Sol en México, se crea un faro que desencadena una guerra relámpago alienígena. En cuestión de horas, sus platillos destruyen toda la infraestructura militar de la tierra.

programme.title: The unthinkable: The unthinkable
programme.desc: Suecia se enfrenta a un misterioso y desconocido ataque. No hay tanques ni ejércitos enemigos acechando, sino sistemas informáticos que se caen repentinamente e instalaciones o infraestructuras que explotan de repente.

programme.title: La señal, el balneario
programme.desc: En un viaje por carretera, Nic y dos amigos son atraídos a una zona aislada por un genio de la informática. Cuando de repente todo se vuelve oscuro, Nic recupera la consciencia, solo para encontrarse en una pesadilla al despertar.

programme.title: Tentáculos de las Bermudas
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero mientras salvan el presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Tormenta colosal
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, una rica viuda de 58 años, aparece ahorcada en su barcaza en Neuilly.
programme.sub-title: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una mujer de 40 años decide embarcarse en un crucero espontáneo sin informar a su familia. Cuando desaparece en la segunda noche del crucero, su familia buscará respuestas y cambiará la forma en que se reportan las desapariciones en el mar.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una subchef a bordo de un crucero abandona su turno inesperadamente y nunca más se la vuelve a ver. ¿La presión de la cocina la llevó al suicidio o hubo juego sucio? ¿Alguien a bordo la vio antes de desaparecer? ¿Qué pistas existen sobre su paradero?

programme.title: Happily Never After: Masacre Premarital
programme.desc: Finalmente, Emely acepta casarse con Manuel. La noche antes de la boda, decoran el salón cuando unos tiros destruyen sus sueños. Esta es una historia poderosa de amor devoto, héroes altruistas y celos destructivos.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Tener y Matar
programme.desc: Beth se casa con su amor del colegio, Mike. Pero su felicidad se esfuma cuando Beth encuentra sangre en su casa y Mike desaparece. En busca de respuestas, la policía se enfrenta a lazos con el hampa, vidas secretas y seducciones.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 18 de julio de 2011, Xavier Baligant, de 29 años, se pone en camino con sus dos hijos tras una semana de vacaciones en Ardèche para regresar a su casa en Nivelles, Bélgica.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver
programme.desc: Este episodio incluye: niño de la lluvia, asesinato con motocicleta, farsa del hospital y la hermana del mejor amigo.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver
programme.desc: Este episodio incluye: El playboy de las drogas, la Sra. Rogers, el ángel de Philip, el reporte de los avances por el secuestro de Memphis.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Cita Mortal en Internet
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, de 52 años, es encontrada muerta en su casa de Marsella. La víctima está desnuda en su cama, con una bolsa de plástico en la cabeza.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: El Policía Asesino
programme.desc: Los bomberos de Barbezieux, Charente, son llamados a un incendio en una gran casa del pueblo.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, una rica viuda de 58 años, aparece ahorcada en su barcaza en Neuilly.
programme.sub-title: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos: Amelia Dyer
programme.desc: Amelia Dyer fue quizás la asesina más prolífica de la historia británica.

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos: Los asesinatos del torso de Cleveland
programme.desc: Los asesinatos sin resolver cometidos por el Carnicero de Kingsbury Run.
programme.sub-title: Los asesinatos del torso de Cleveland

programme.title: Memoria Negra: El Crimen De Cala Murada
programme.desc: Año 2006. Katerina Buchler es asesinada de un disparo en su domicilio de Cala Murada, Mallorca. Su marido, Rudolf Eberhard, era el único testigo de los hechos.

programme.title: Memoria Negra: El Descuartizador De Pere Garau
programme.desc: 2 de octubre del año 2013. El barrio de Pere Garau, en Palma de Mallorca, despierta con la noticia de que uno de sus vecinos ha confesado en sede policial haber matado y descuartizado a su hermano.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: Drew Peterson
programme.desc: Stephen, hijo de Drew Peterson, no puede creerlo cuando su padre es acusado de asesinar a su tercera esposa y de la desaparición de su cuarta esposa. La prensa acecha y Stephen protege a sus hermanos y se enfrenta a la verdad: ¿es su padre culpable?

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: El asesino de Craigslist
programme.desc: Tonya, hija de Richard Beasley, sabe sobre el pasado turbio de su padre, pero cuando abraza la religión, ella cree que ha cambiado de vida. Pero cuando comete una serie de asesinatos, Tonya queda devastada.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: Harry "el Garfio" Aleman
programme.desc: Franky, hija de Harry Aleman, apoya a su padre incluso cuando lo acusan de ser uno de los sicarios de la mafia de Chicago y durante todo su juicio por asesinato. Pero, ¿podrá seguir a su lado cuando su segundo juicio por asesinato entra en la historia?

programme.title: Clarividentes
programme.desc: Un brutal asesinato en Connecticut deja a la policía sin pistas ni sospechosos. Una pareja en California busca desesperadamente a su hijo desaparecido. En cada caso, la policía recurre a psíquicos en busca de orientación.

programme.title: Planetas Alienígenas
programme.desc: Este documental ofrece un viaje cautivador a través del cosmos, mostrando la inmensa escala del universo. Los avances tecnológicos, como los telescopios espaciales y las misiones internacionales, nos permiten mapear planetas potencialmente habitables.

programme.title: Fotografías Auténticas de un Extraterrestre: El Caso Caponi
programme.desc: Los encuentros de Caponi con extraterrestres de 1993. Las fotos reales muestran vida extraterrestre.

programme.title: Base De Dulce: Los Nuevos Illuminati
programme.desc: Dulce, Nuevo México, es un punto de acceso para fenómenos misteriosos y una supuesta colaboración militar secreta entre humanos y extraterrestres.

programme.title: OVNI: Primer Contacto
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en avistamientos de OVNIs y encuentros cercanos que involucran aeronaves comerciales y militares, trayéndoles los relatos más asombrosos de pilotos que han presenciado objetos voladores no identificados durante sus vuelos.

programme.title: Hopkinsville: Los Duendes Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Una familia lucha contra los alienígenas goblins en un misterioso encuentro, lo que provoca debates e investigaciones. El miedo impulsa sus acciones.

programme.title: Roswell: La Verdad No Revelada
programme.desc: El comandante Jesse Marcel investiga extraños escombros encontrados en 1947, a pesar de que le dijeron que era un globo meteorológico.

programme.title: La Verdad Oculta
programme.desc: Con el investigador Pier Giorgio Caria, exploramos desde los primeros contactos con razas extraterrestres hasta los retos geopolíticos actuales, buscando un despertar y contacto colectivo con nuestros hermanos estelares.

programme.title: El Accidente OVNI en Roswell
programme.desc: Encubrimientos y conspiraciones... ¿Qué sucedió realmente esa noche en Roswell, en 1947?

programme.title: Génesis Alienígena
programme.desc: La abiogénesis y la exploración espacial revelan cómo la vida podría surgir en el cosmos. Este viaje va de los mitos de creación al laboratorio moderno, hasta la búsqueda de vida extraterrestre más allá de la Tierra.

programme.title: Alienígenas Ancestrales: Los Archivos de la India
programme.desc: La vanguardia espiritual y tecnológica de las antiguas civilizaciones indias y sus interacciones con razas evolucionadas de las estrellas.

programme.title: Sociedades secretas y el nuevo orden mundial
programme.desc: En casi todas las culturas existen leyendas que narran sobre una Raza Antigua que pobló la Tierra hace millones de años. Esta raza tiene orígenes extraterrestres y era inmensamente inteligente y científicamente avanzada.

programme.title: La Maldición del SS Ourang Medan
programme.desc: En Indonesia, en 1947, señales de socorro del SS Ourang Medan desatan el terror. Los rescatistas huyen del barco, encendiendo teorías de conspiración—desde experimentos militares hasta asaltos paranormales y antiguos monstruos marinos.

programme.title: Proyecto Serpo
programme.desc: 2005: Ex agente revela un informe de 3.000 páginas sobre una misión secreta de intercambio ET al planeta Serpo

programme.title: Tiburón Zombie
programme.desc: Una escapada perfecta para cuatro amigos se convierte en una lucha por la supervivencia cuando se ven obligados a pelear contra un tiburón experimental.

programme.title: Rec 2
programme.desc: Secuela de la película [•REC] (2006), con el mismo formato de falso documental. Quince minutos después del final de la primera parte, un grupo de policías entran en el edificio acompañados por un doctor con tal de conseguir la sangre de los infectados.

programme.title: Rec 4: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Una reportera de televisión es rescatada y enviada a un viaje a través del océano, pero la persigue un virus mortal.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: En un futuro cercano, un virus de proporciones épicas se ha apoderado del planeta y la humanidad está perdiendo su control sobre la supervivencia. Su única esperanza es encontrar una cura y aislar a los infectados.

programme.title: Alarma en el Expreso
programme.desc: Centroeuropa. El tren Transcontinental sufre un retraso. Los pasajeros pernoctan en un hotel. Iris Henderson habla con una anciana, la Sra. Froy. En el tren, Iris se da cuenta de la desaparición de la anciana, pero los pasajeros afirman que no existe.

programme.title: El autoestopista
programme.desc: Dos pescadores recogen a un autoestopista que resulta ser un convicto psicótico.

programme.title: El ministerio del miedo
programme.desc: Tras dos años de reclusión, Stephen Neale abandona el sanatorio mental de Lembridge. Se encuentra entonces con un mundo distinto que nada tiene que ver con lo que él conocía.

programme.title: El doble asesinato en la calle Morgue
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un sádico doctor de París se dedica a secuestrar a mujeres jóvenes para realizar experimentos que puedan ayudarle a confirmar sus teorías sobre la evolución del mono al hombre.

programme.title: Barba azul
programme.desc: Un peligroso asesino, apodado Barba Azul, tiene aterrorizados a los habitantes de París. A todos menos a Lucille, una modesta costurera que, desoyendo el clamor popular, decide salir a dar un paseo nocturno por la ciudad.

programme.title: Fear X
programme.desc: Harry (John Turturro), un agente de seguridad de un centro comercial, se dedica a investigar obsesivamente el asesinato de su mujer.

programme.title: La Casa Roja
programme.desc: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto a su hija adolescente adoptiva, sobre una granja abandonada escondida, ubicada en lo profundo del bosque.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Siete completos desconocidos con características de personalidad muy variadas son colocados involuntariamente en un laberinto interminable que contiene trampas mortales.

programme.title: Acero azul
programme.desc: Una novata del cuerpo de policía se ve envuelta en un juego del gato y el ratón con un psicópata con una pistola que se obsesiona con ella.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff
programme.desc: El conde Zaroff es un loco millonario que vive en una isla solitaria y se dedica a cazar a los náufragos como si fueran animales.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El equipo de Mutante X debe detener a un asesino en serie que deja pistas a sus próximas víctimas en forma de rompecabezas.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Cuando Lexa es drogada sin saberlo con una sustancia letal, el equipo debe correr para encontrar el antídoto antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Se llama al equipo de Mutante X para investigar actividades extrañas que ocurren en un hospital local.

programme.title: Ascensión: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Christa se niega a recibir las obligadas inoculaciones. Para demostrar que no son peligrosas, Ophelia se inyecta una y le provoca un coma.

programme.title: Ascensión: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Christa se niega a recibir las obligadas inoculaciones. Para demostrar que no son peligrosas, Ophelia se inyecta una y le provoca un coma.

programme.title: Ascensión: Episodio 6
programme.desc: La energía generada por Christa demuestra que el experimento del Ascension funciona. La directora Warren intenta hacerlo público, pero los planes se tuercen.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Un planeta de sobrevivientes de la Mancomunidad liderados por la ex prometida de Dylan es invitado a unirse a la nueva Mancomunidad, pero cuando votan para no unirse, los Magog son sospechosos de jugar sucio.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Un agente del Abismo intenta atraer a Harper para que se una al Magog.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Cuando rescatan a un joven príncipe de un levantamiento que mata al resto de su familia, se les pide a Dylan y Tyr que sean sus asesores.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan y su nueva flota de la Mancomunidad se amen a la flota Drago-Kazov, pero la encuentran mucho más grande de lo esperado.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Los huevos De Magog en Harper están empezando a eclosionar, así que el equipo construye una máquina Teseract.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan se hace cargo de una barcaza turística en un intento de escapar de mercenarios.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Una identificación del cuerpo sale mal cuando resulta que el ex compañero de tripulación de Beka no está muerto en absoluto.
programme.sub-title: Que se Recuerden Todos Mis Pecados

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Andrómeda rescata a la gente moribunda de una deriva, pero pronto se convierten en zombies siendo controlados por una mente colmena.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Un anciano planifica usar alguno de los superpoderes de Curtis para regresar en el tiempo y asesinar a Hitler. Pero el plan sienta mal y la banda se dan cuentan en un mundo alternativo.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Mientras hace un servicio a la comunidad en el hospital local, Kelly se ve atrapada en el cuerpo de Jen, una víctima en coma. Jen, paseando en el cuerpo de Kelly, sale, dejando a Kelly en coma.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 6
programme.desc: Después de una noche bebido con una chica misteriosa, Rudy descubre que tiene un extraño superpoder STD. Con solo 24 horas para deshacer el hechizo, Rudy acude a Simon para ayudarle a encontrar a la chica.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 7
programme.desc: Cuando Seth descubre el superpoder de la resurrección, lo utiiza para devolverle la vida a su exnovia de nuevo a la vida. Pero al poco tiempo se da cuenta de que el nuevo superpoder tiene inesperadas consecuencias.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 8
programme.desc: La banda está sorprendida cuando un falso medium con un superpoder trae los rostros familiares del pasado de nuevo a la vida. Se encuentran cara a cara con dos trabajadores a prueba que serán asesinados.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 1

After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Killing Season

programme.title: Security

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix
programme.desc: In June 1967, Jimi Hendrix returned to his native country and transformed the cultural, musical and fashion landscapes. Punctuated by Hendrix lighting his instrument on fire, the U.S. debut performance of the Jimi Hendrix Experience at the Monterey Pop Festival propelled the guitarist and his band mates to the top ranks of international rock royalty.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.desc: A multitrack mixtape of characters are set on a collision course in a fever dream of showdowns and battles.

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Slightly Single in LA
programme.desc: Fun, flirty and downright outrageous. Independent, LA singleton Dale (Lacey Chabert, Mean Girls) is sick and tired of her troublesome love life. On the verge of giving up, she is reunited with an old friend - successful heartthrob and rock star Zach. Is this Dale's lucky chance to fall in love? Also starring Jenna Dewan (Step Up) and Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls). Perfect for a girls night in!

programme.title: Miss Virginia
programme.desc: An inspiring, heart-warming and extremely relevant true story, starring Uzo Aduba (Orange is the New Black), Niles Fitch (This is Us), Matthew Modine (Full Metal Jacket) and Vanessa Williams (Shaft). When Virginia Walden an impoverished single mother is losing her fifteen-year-old son to the rough streets of Washington D.C. she launches a movement to change the system that is responsible.

programme.title: The White King
programme.desc: Djata is a care-free 12-year-old growing up in a brutal dictatorship shut off from the outside world. When the government imprisons his father, Peter, and Djata and his mother Hannah are labelled traitors, the boy will not rest until he sees his father again.

programme.title: Masters of Love
programme.desc: A funny, moving look at the complications of modern love, starring Edinburgh Festival Best Newcomer Ciarˆn Dowd (Drunk History). A group of friends are at different stages in their relationships and none of them are convinced about what they're doing: Emmy and Samantha are getting married, Josh and Jenifer are breaking up and Niall is sleeping around but can any of them hold down a relationship?

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: The Man in the Hat
programme.desc: The Man in the Hat (Ciarán Hinds) journeys through France in a Fiat 500 accompanied by a framed photograph of an unknown woman. He is pursued by five angry men in a Citroën Dyane.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, a daughter of wealthy British parents, has no interest in the social life of the London elite. Balls, receptions, and the British aristocracy bring her only boredom.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Romance starring Lindy Booth. After a messy public break-up, a woman retreats to her uncle's ranch - where a run-in with a Hollywood actor sparks an unexpected connection.

programme.title: Christmas Unwrapped
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a man who insists that all of the Christmas gifts his charity gives are magically supplied by Santa Claus. Starring Amber Stevens West (2020)

programme.title: Christmas in the Air
programme.desc: Robert, a widower and father of two children, enlists Lydia to help him juggle his chaotic work-life balance at Christmastime. Will their close relationship lead to love? Stars Catherine Bell. (2017)

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Planner
programme.desc: (2017) Romantic drama with Jocelyn Hudon. A woman is hired to plan her cousin's elaborate wedding and things are going perfectly - until a handsome stranger arrives asking questions about the groom.

programme.title: CHRISTMAS LOVE LETTER
programme.desc: (2019) Intriguing Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. A relationship advice columnist receives an unsigned love letter. But as she hunts for the mystery writer, can she also find true love?

programme.title: The Wedding Arrangements
programme.desc: When talented botanist Violet needs help preparing flower arrangements for a high-profile wedding, she calls upon Jack, a handsome nature photographer who has taken over responsibility for his grandfather's flower shed.

programme.title: A Slice of Chicago Romance
programme.desc: In a suburb of Chicago, Romanos & Juliatos, two pizza places, have competed for the town's business for years. When both restaurants get passed down to—RILEY (30s) and SARAH (30s)—after a new pizza chain moves into town, the new bosses struggle to compete after they begin to fall for one another.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature.

programme.title: Cooking with Love
programme.desc: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn't have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly's life as a last minute replacement host.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he's divorced, broke and hasn't written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë's superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Ball
programme.desc: It's a fairy tale come true for Allison, and her daughter, Lily, when Lily's estranged father, Charles, makes a visit to California. Charles may have come on official business, but his real mission is to find Allison and make amends for lost time.

programme.title: Not Cinderella's Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: April Monroe is a superstar doctor at a big New York hospital, who has fallen head-over-heels for charming veterinarian Jesse, and their relationship seems to be heading in the right direction except for one thing: Jesse is completely tight-lipped about his Amish family.

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting
programme.desc: It has been years since Ned Stevens, a charming self-made success, lost his wife Kate to cancer. Yet he still can't let go of her memory and move forward with his life.. But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

programme.title: My Life As a Dead Girl.
programme.desc: Chelsea killed by Brittany's pimp Brittany assumes her identity, truth emerges.

programme.title: Zombie at 17.
programme.desc: 17-year-old Tia Scott has had a pretty normal life.

programme.title: Embrace of the Vampire.
programme.desc: A virginal college freshman is plagued by terrifying hallucinations.

programme.title: Wayne and Mary/Holly/Linda
programme.desc: Wayne and Mary woke up to find their farm house surrounded by a cloud of gas.

programme.title: My Life As a Dead Girl.
programme.desc: Chelsea killed by Brittany's pimp Brittany assumes her identity, truth emerges.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: A fashion blogger gets a new number and steps into a glamorous life, but falls for her predecessor's ex.

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: When Diana inherits half her uncle's vineyard, she is surprised to find a rule requiring her to work the land with new co-owner Seth or risk losing the land.

programme.title: Love & Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop owners despise each other but begin to fall in love while sending each other messages on their friends' behalf.

programme.title: Love Map
programme.desc: A self-assured relationship columnist is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to Florida.

programme.title: Dear Christmas
programme.desc: A podcast host returns home for Christmas and sparks begin to fly with a local firefighter.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Suzy is just home from the hospital and needs to be cared for around the clock. Her husband Duncan decides the best medicine Suzy could possibly have--and a Christmas present she'll never forget--is a ride on a real Ferris wheel set up in their own back yard. Why a Ferris wheel? Because it was while riding one many moons ago that Duncan asked Suzy to marry him.

programme.title: This Christmas
programme.desc: This year, Christmas with the Whitfield's promises to be one they will never forget. All the siblings have come home for the first time in years and they've brought plenty of baggage with them. As the Christmas tree is trimmed and the lights are hung, secrets are revealed and family bonds are tested. As their lives converge, they join together and help each other discover the true meaning of family.

programme.title: When I Think Of Christmas
programme.desc: Sara returns home and reconnects with former flame Josh when they perform in the Christmas concert.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: Becca, an anxious, non-vampire teen, is torn between two boys. Before she can choose, Becca must get around her controlling father, who embarrasses Becca by treating her like a child. Meanwhile, Becca's friends contend with their own romantic issues, all of which collide at the prom.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Seeking a way to save their doomed world, a crew of tiny, human-looking aliens arrives on Earth in the perfect disguise--a spaceship shaped like an ordinary man.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The Girl from San Lorenzo
programme.desc: Two outlaws posing as Cisco and Pancho are wreaking havoc. When the real Cisco and Pancho are captured, the criminals plan a final heist, using the duo as alibis. After breaking them out of jail, the real heroes have a chance to escape and clear their names by capturing the imposters. Will they succeed or be caught again?

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: A judge encounters a man (Frank Latimore) he once wronged after an Apache attack. The attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

programme.title: Mackenzie's Raiders EP13-16
programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

programme.title: Silver Lode
programme.desc: In Silver Lode, Dan Ballard is arrested by 4 Marshals for murder and theft but he denies the charges and searches for the real culprit even as the townsfolk start abandoning him.

programme.title: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Dublin, Ireland in search of the missing crown of the last King of Ireland.

programme.title: A Vanishing Art
programme.desc: Accompanying Max the magician, Sydney and Nigel journey to Atlantic City, New Jersey in search of Hungary's lost and allegedly cursed Royal Scepter.

programme.title: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to France to look for the lost wedding vows of Josephine Pontoise and Guy de Bourdin, which would prove their heir is the rightful owner of St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to France to find the lost stones from Marie Antoinette's Crown.

programme.title: Nothing But the Truth
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are reunited with Stewie Harper in the search for the Chalice of Truth in France.

programme.title: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Paris, France after the Sword of Jacques de Molay, Grand Master of the Knights Templar. Rival relic hunter Rita Rosellini is also after the sword.

programme.title: Possessed
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are in Brussels, Belgium in search of the sacred sundial of Zeus in order to stop the Vampires.

programme.title: Memories of Montmartre
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Paris, France to find a stolen locket, so they can clear Sydney's dead grandmother of the charges.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: The Middle Ages may never be the same after street smart Jamal Walker falls into a moat at the Medieval World theme park and finds himself transported back in time.

programme.title: Superfast!
programme.desc: Undercover cop, Paul White joins Vin Serento's LA gang of illegal street racers as they plan to double cross LA's crime kingpin. The gang's outrageous wheel-spinning plan is as daring as it is ridiculous and will see them towing the whole damn restaurant, at crazy speeds, half way across the city.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

programme.title: Searching (2018)
programme.desc: 37 hours after David Kim's (John Cho) 16-year-old daughter goes missing without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.

programme.title: Runaway (1984)
programme.desc: A cop of the future, an evil genius and a murderous robotic force in a deadly chase of runaway terror.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: A hit woman's life is turned completely around when she meets a young boy who awakens in her a maternal instinct she never knew she had.

programme.title: A Little Trip to Heaven
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Abraham Holt travels to a tiny town in rural Minnesota to look into a particularly unusual insurance claim stemming from a horrific car accident. As Holt examines the scene of the wreck, it all seems a bit too perfect. And when he interviews Isold McBride and her shifty husband, Fred -- the impoverished beneficiaries of the massive, recently initiated life-insurance policy -- he begins to suspect that something is amiss.

programme.title: Love Again
programme.desc: Amidst a distant relationship with his father and losing his girlfriend to his best friend, Nathan's brokenness leads him on a journey of rediscovering hope and a healing heart to love again.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, The Cowboys a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves reigned over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate had finally caught up with them - and now the merciless gang has but a single surviving member. When a deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen ("Green Book") stars as an undercover FBI agent who has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Hard Boiled [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets : crimes aux enchères
programme.desc: Miles Wexford est retrouvé mort dans sa boutique. Jennifer mène sa propre enquête lorsqu'elle découvre qu'il était criblé de dettes de jeu.

programme.title: Amour et mécanique
programme.desc: Jess accepte de participer à une exposition de restauration de voitures et apprend que son ex-petit ami est son principal concurrent.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden
programme.desc: Une libraire participe à l'enquête sur le meurtre d'un détective de police qu'elle n'a jamais pu supporter.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden
programme.desc: Une libraire passionnée d'intrigues policières enquête sur la disparition de son neveu et de son colocataire, dont la petite amie est morte.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden
programme.desc: Conviée à une soirée meurtre et mystère, une bibliothécaire voit la fiction se confondre avec la réalité.

programme.title: First Men In The Moon
programme.desc: Spectacular adaptation of H. G. Well's novel of adventure and space travel.

programme.title: Human Desire
programme.desc: A railoroad engineer is drawn into deadly romantic triangle.

programme.title: Jason And The Argonauts

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Sarah Brightman
programme.desc: Sarah Brightman is an English soprano singer who has won 160 gold and platinum albums in 34 countries. Only the soundtrack to the musical The Phantom of the Opera, played by Sarah, sold more than 40 million copies.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix
programme.desc: In June 1967, Jimi Hendrix returned to his native country and transformed the cultural, musical and fashion landscapes. Punctuated by Hendrix lighting his instrument on fire, the U.S. debut performance of the Jimi Hendrix Experience at the Monterey Pop Festival propelled the guitarist and his band mates to the top ranks of international rock royalty.

programme.title: James Taylor
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Durante un asalto a un banco, Rex, un tipo que suele hablar consigo mismo o con su conciencia, detiene a los asaltantes y, tras varios disparos, logra asegurar todo el establecimiento pero, desafortunadamente, toda la misión, a pesar de haber sido un éxito, termina de manera trágica, por lo que es juzgado y encarcelado. Tras cumplir su condena, se muda a Finlandia para tomarse un respiro, pero termina atrapado por una retorcida familia caníbal que esconde un secreto muy oscuro.

programme.title: Tomb Invader
programme.desc: La arqueóloga Alabama Channing es reclutada por un misterioso multimillonario para que le ayude a encontrar una antigua reliquia china. El mismo tesoro que buscaba su madre antes de desaparecer.
